symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1234: `alter page M.P { add parameters $X: T; }` fails with `mismatched input 'parameters' expecting VARIABLES_KW`; adding a parameter to an existing page needed CREATE OR REPLACE, which loses what describe does not round-trip (page-variable input bindings, combobox association bindings).
cause: Capability gap, not a defect: ALTER PAGE had `add/drop variables` but no parameter operations at any layer — grammar, AST, PageMutator, executor.
fix: `alterPageAddParameter: ADD PARAMETERS pageParameter` / `alterPageDropParameter: DROP PARAMETERS VARIABLE` reusing CREATE's `pageParameter` rule and a now-shared `buildPageParameter`; `PageMutator.AddParameter/DropParameter`; the raw-BSON mutator gets the element from a new `Deps.SerializeParameter`, which the codec backend implements with CREATE's own `pageParameterToGen` / `snippetParameterToGen`.
insight: Do not hand-build the parameter BSON in the mutator the way AddVariable does: a page parameter's key set is version-gated (IsRequired/DefaultValue only on 11.5+), and only the engine knows the project version — route it through Deps so ALTER and CREATE write the same element. The parse fix alone was not enough: the first real-project run (11.12.1, `mx check`) failed CE5601 because the page had a Url without a `{Order}` segment — CREATE catches that as MDL-PAGE20 but an ALTER never had parameters to check. Mock tests passed throughout; only the `mxcli new` + `docker check` run found it. The guard reads the URL the statement ENDS with, so `set (Url: …)` in the same block satisfies it. Drop is refused while a Forms$PageVariable PageParameter/SnippetParameter or an Expression/XPath string names `$X` (whole-token match: `$XList` is not a use). Fixture testdata/expr-checker Account_Edit binds a data view to $Account — a ready-made in-use parameter.
